content: Government representatives met with CJP and shared draft notifications. Bihar and Assam governments will withdraw FIRs and release arrested protesters. Future legal action against demonstrators will also be prevented. Union government and other BJP/NDA states will release similar notifications soon. Protesters will not be left alone as all are in this together.

title: One killed as violence, rigging claims mar first phase of PoK polls
content: The Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) alleged that 35-year-old party worker Mukhtar Younus was shot dead during voting in Nikyal in Kotli district. The party blamed supporters of the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N) for the firing. "Our party worker, Mukhtar Yunus, was killed and two others injured during incidents of firing by the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N) candidates," the PPP said. PPP chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari questioned the role of the authorities after the incident.

title: India squad for Sri Lanka Tests: Jadeja returns; Bumrah picked with a rider
content: The men's selection committee announced the squad for the Sri Lanka Test series. Ravindra Jadeja returns to the team after being rested for the Afghanistan Test. Saransh Jain has earned his maiden call-up to the Indian squad. Washington Sundar remains unavailable for the first Test match. Sai Sudharsan and Jasprit Bumrah's availability depends on fitness clearance.

title: Microsoft CEO on Wall Street being upset on Chinese open source AI models
content: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella dismisses concerns about cheaper Chinese artificial intelligence models. He argues that global trust in American infrastructure and its open ecosystem remains key. Chinese AI models often run on American hyperscalers, which are vital for global deployment. Nadella believes Western companies can leverage open-weight models on secure platforms. This approach ensures continued competitiveness and technological leadership for the United States.

title: India refused illegal migrants as UK didn't extradite Nirav Modi: Priti Patel
content: Former UK Home Secretary Priti Patel stated India refused migrant returns. This refusal was linked to the UK's failure to extradite fugitive jeweler Nirav Modi. Patel expressed dismay that Modi remained in London for seven years. She believes India was angry over Britain's stance on his extradition. India has denied opposing the return of illegal migrants.

title: No planes, no problem: India's 'no 1 airport' Khajuraho has zero flights

The survey results have prompted questions about the Airports Authority of India's evaluation criteria.  Flights to Delhi and Varanasi are expected to resume operations in October.  Passengers praised the airport's facilities, cleanliness, and staff conduct.

title: Ordered wedding dress on Instagram, never got it: Boutique told to pay Rs 36,880
content: A Kerala consumer commission ordered an Instagram boutique to pay compensation. The boutique took full payment for two wedding dresses but delivered only one. It also failed to refund the money for the undelivered dress. The commission ruled that social media sellers are bound by consumer protection laws. The boutique must pay Rs 36,880 for the undelivered item and inconvenience.

title: Canada clarifies work permit rules for international students after rejections
content: Canada's immigration authority issued a clarification on student work permits.  Unauthorized work can lead to serious consequences and future permit refusals.  Portage College advised protesting Indian students to seek legal counsel.  Students must adhere to specific conditions for working while studying.  Retaining important documents is crucial for future immigration processes.

title: 'You can't take 1-2 games': Ex-cricketer's blunt warning to Rohit and Kohli

Recent series performances have fueled discussions about their long-term plans.  Former player Deep Dasgupta believes their places are secure based on merit.  The focus remains on immediate impact and consistent performance from the veterans.

title: Surfside Beach loses $545K in email scam; contractor cites ignored red flags
content: A payment of $545,598 intended for Wildcat Construction has become the focus of an ongoing fraud investigation in Surfside Beach, South Carolina, after the money was allegedly redirected to a scammer-controlled bank account through a sophisticated email scam. The fraud began during what appeared to be a routine email conversation about issuing payment for completed work.

title: New study: Why some dreams feel real — personality, sleep, and Covid play a role
content: Ever wondered why some dreams feel so realistic that they stay with you long after you wake up, while others seem like strange, disconnected stories? A new study has found that the answer may lie in your personality, sleeping habits, and even major events happening around the world. The findings are based on an analysis of more than 3,700 dream and waking-life reports collected from 287 adults aged between 18 and 70.

title: American man arrested for wiping his phone during airport search; here's why
content: A federal case in Atlanta questions privacy software use as criminal intent evidence. Prosecutors accuse Samuel Tunick of wiping his phone to prevent authorities from accessing its contents. GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused operating system, is central to the ongoing legal proceedings. Authorities in Europe also reportedly view GrapheneOS usage with suspicion. GrapheneOS developers state their software is legal and protects against unauthorized data extraction.

title: 'Can't bribe them': Trump's 'will beat them' warning to Iran despite talks
content: Despite Trump's remarks, tensions remained high across the region. Saudi Arabia, Jordan and Iraq reported drone attacks on Monday, suggesting that hostilities had not completely subsided despite the pause in the US bombing campaign. Washington halted its two-week air campaign against Iran on Saturday in a surprise policy shift by Trump after nearly five months of conflict. Iran said it had not abandoned diplomacy but denied reports that it had sought talks with Washington.

title: 101 murder accused, 989 with crime records marched to Parliament: Delhi Police

Accused in sexual assault cases also joined the march, police reported. The police examined 2,873 individuals involved in attacking officers and vandalizing vehicles. Action will continue against those with criminal history, while student cases will be dropped.

title: CWG 2026 medal table: Where does India stand after six medals on Day 5?

Sharmila Dhankar's historic para-athletics gold led the charge, supported by three silvers and two bronzes. Australia remained atop the table with 59 medals, ahead of England (32) and Canada (21).

title: 'Jana Nayagan' BO day 5: Vijay's film sees big Monday drop

The film's net earnings in India reached Rs 134.90 crore after five days, while worldwide gross collections stood at Rs 233.24 crore. Notably, occupancy rates surged during the evening and night shows on Monday.

title: CWG Day 5: Sharmila claims India's first-ever para-athletics gold, headlines six-medal haul
content: India enjoyed a memorable day at the Commonwealth Games as Sharmila Dhankar became the country's first-ever para-athletics gold medallist, while Sarvesh Kushare, Valluri Ajaya Babu and Gyaneshwari Yadav won silver medals. Bindyarani Devi added bronze, Indian boxers advanced to the quarterfinals, but athletics and swimming saw mixed results, with Gurindervir Singh and Tejas Shirse enduring disappointing outings.

title: Nolan Wells case takes a shocking turn as online trolls target grieving mother’s career

The reviews appear unrelated to her work and are being described as review bombing. Supporters are urging review platforms to remove non-genuine ratings, saying no grieving family should face attacks that threaten their livelihood.

title: Patrick Mahomes, Brittany Mahomes donate $1.625m to help East Texas kids
content: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes made a lasting impact off the football field with a $1.625 million partnership through the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation. Announced in October 2023, the initiative supports Boys & Girls Clubs in East Texas, Greater Kansas City and Lubbock, while also funding scholarships for hundreds of children and upgrading Club facilities. Here's how the Kansas City Chiefs star and his wife turned their hometown ties into a long-term commitment to help young people build brighter futures.

title: Brock Purdy and Jenna Brandt’s net worth in 2026: Earnings, endorsements

Most of the publicly reported household wealth is from Purdy’s NFL contract, endorsements and investments, while Brandt’s finances remain private after her college volleyball career. Their financial story includes brand partnerships, real estate, family life and a fast-evolving lifestyle after Purdy’s rise as a well-compensated San Francisco 49ers quarterback.

title: The family behind Roger Federer's rise to tennis greatness

His wife, Mirka Federer, stood beside him through injuries and success, while his parents helped shape his values from childhood. During his emotional retirement, Federer thanked them with heartfelt words, showing that his greatest achievement was never just tennis, but the people who supported him throughout his journey.

title: FAA flags incorrectly installed seats on several Boeing 737 Max jets
content: The FAA has proposed mandatory inspections for 453 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft seats. Improperly installed seat assemblies could disengage during turbulence or emergency landings. This condition might injure passengers and crew or block the evacuation aisle. Boeing supports the FAA's decision to make these recommendations mandatory. The directive applies to US-registered aircraft, with no deadline specified yet.

title: Supreme Court: Insolvency shield is for firm, not promoters
content: a moratorium against the corporate debtor does not give protection to promoters and directors, and proceedings can continue against them . a bench of justices quashed an order passed by the national consumer Disputes Redressal Commission . the court allowed the plea of homebuyers who challenged the NCDRC order .
